entries.paragraph: The Qal Passive is a passive form of the Qal stem. It looks similar to (and is sometimes identified as) the Pual or the Hophal stem.

entries.label: hithpalpel
entries.text: The Hithpalpel is an extremely rare stem formation that is similar to the Hithpael.
entries.paragraph: The Hithpalpel is an extremely rare stem formation that is similar to the Hithpael. It expresses the reflexive voice of the Pilpel stem.

entries.label: pulal
entries.text: The Pulal is a rare stem formation that is similar to the Pual.
entries.paragraph: The Pulal is a rare stem formation that it similar to the Pual. It expresses the passive voice of the Pilel and/or Palel stems.
entries.note: Spelling corrected from the source: “that it similar” → “that is similar”.

entries.label: hothpaal
entries.text: The Hothpaal is an extremely rare stem formation that is derived from the Hithpael.
entries.paragraph: The Hothpaal is an extremely rare stem formation that is derived from the Hithpael. It generally expresses action in passive voice.

entries.label: palel
entries.text: The Palel is a rare stem formation that is similar to the Piel and expresses the same range of meanings.

entries.label: nithpael
entries.text: The Nithpael is an extremely rare stem formation that is derived from both the Hithpael and Niphal.
entries.paragraph: The Nithpael is an extremely rare stem formation that is derived from both the Hithpael and Niphal. It expresses the reflexive voice of the Piel stem.

entries.label: tiphil
entries.text: The Tiphil is an extremely rare stem formation that is similar to the Hiphil and expresses causative action in active voice.
